embedding.note: One embedding batch per generation (taste + candidates + negatives + liked, ~2k tokens) costs ~2 neurons at the published rate; the 5-neuron allowance is a conservative flat figure.

source: Cloudflare Workers AI pricing page, https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ (page updated 2026-11-12; rates read 2026-11-15). Neurons per million tokens. All four models survive the 20 Nov 2026 deprecation (official changelog, 5 Nov 2026) — @cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8 does NOT and is deliberately excluded.
